question: Dental Caries result in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Softened enamel.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dental caries **is a common chronic infection caused by cariogenic bacteria that cling to teeth, mainly **Streptococcus Mutans**.
 
• These bacteria break down sugars into acid over time.
 
• **Dental caries can result in the softening of the enamel**, which is the hard, outer layer of the tooth.
 
• This happens due to the acid produced by the bacteria that breaks down the minerals in the enamel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bleeding gums**: This is a common **symptom of gum disease**, which is caused by the buildup of plaque and tartar on the teeth. It can also be a sign of other health conditions such as leukemia or vitamin deficiencies.
 
• **Broken tooth**: A broken tooth can occur **due to trauma or decay**. It can cause pain and sensitivity, and may require dental treatment such as a filling, crown, or extraction.
 
• **Foul-smelling breath**: This can be a symptom of** poor oral hygiene**, gum disease, or other health conditions such as diabetes or liver disease.
